subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: If defective routing evidence has already authorized an accepted or merged proposal, then the system shall preserve the shipped state, emit an operator decision brief listing every exact affected artifact, and require an explicit incident/remediation disposition
intent: no automatic destructive rollback; exact accepted artifacts are named for human disposition
fit_criterion: a seeded late discovery produces one complete brief and never silently retains a valid-routing claim or mutates accepted code
